source.dataset: Original neutral Z-Anatomy source meshes; same fixed source and coordinate system as the axillary module

coordinateSystem.pose: source neutral standing anatomy with arm alongside trunk
coordinateSystem.transform: Original FBX mesh matrixWorld, then uniform scale 0.01 cm to m. No source fitting, repositioning, clipping or nerve reconstruction.

plane.uMeaning: positive screen horizontal points anteriorly (+Z); left is posterior
plane.vMeaning: positive image depth points medially (+X) from the right neck
plane.nMeaning: plane normal points cranially (+Y); u cross v equals n; positive image depth is drawn downward
plane.status: source-coordinate geometric reference only, not a validated clinical ultrasound scan plane
plane.levelLimit: Source Y 1.468 lies within the C6 vertebra bounding Y range; this does not identify individual nerve branches as C6.

suggestedSliceRange.meaning: Horizontal source-coordinate geometry exploration; not procedural positioning or clinical scan correspondence.

sourceNerveAudit.note: Anterior/posterior spinal root source meshes are separate multi-level structures, not substitutes for individually identified plexus-forming ventral rami. No neural component was assigned a cervical level.

limitations: Source geometry and named mesh presence are verified; clinical anatomical accuracy and completeness have not been independently validated.
Brachial plexus roots are clinically plexus-forming anterior/ventral rami, distinct from intrathecal anterior/posterior spinal roots; this source proximal mesh is unsegmented.
Independent named upper/middle/lower trunk meshes exist, but visual apposition and source hierarchy do not prove complete connected anatomy.
C5/C6/C7 nerve selection, phrenic nerve, fascial sheath, injectable compartment, safe needle path and anesthetic spread are not supplied.
The geometric plane uses original neutral anatomy. No patient-specific ultrasound registration, procedural pose or clinical scan-plane calibration was performed.
Selected source meshes remain whole; the UI may restrict the right-neck ROI visually without altering anatomy. No mesh is created to fill a source gap.
